sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: On-Site Factory Pre-Shipment Quality Control and Audit Agency

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 2012)
Panama-Canada Foreign Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (FIPA, in force 2024)
CAFTA-DR (Dominican Republic-Central America Free Trade Agreement)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 23 of 27 April 2015 on the Prevention, Detection and Sanctioning of Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism, as amended; Executive Decree No. 201 of 23 June 2017 (Beneficial Owners Registry and Obligations); Executive Decree No. 223 of 2020 (UBO Registry reform and filing procedures); Unified Executive Decree No. 363 of 2015 (AML/CFT organic regulations); Agreement of the Plenary of the Supreme Court No. 107 of 2016 (access to beneficial ownership information by the Mercantile Registry); directives and guidance of the Financial Analysis Unit (UAF) and the Superintendency of Banks.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original notarized copy of the beneficial owner's passport
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent public notary of the country of origin (authenticating authority at origin)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the country of origin unless the origin country is not a Hague Convention member, in which case mandatory consular legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Evidence of residential address of the beneficial owner (recent utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility service provider or regulated bank in the jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or certified by the issuing bank/notary then apostilled by the competent authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Corporate Existence for any corporate UBO or intermediate entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry in the corporate UBO's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the registry's competent authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Panamanian resident agent for incorporation and registered office duties
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of the appointer's domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; if the appointer's jurisdiction is not a Hague Convention member, consular legalization at the nearest Panamanian consulate

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, and authorised signatories are mandatorily screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions Lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Lists, and the domestic Panamanian UAF published list of Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) and prohibited entities. Enhanced due diligence and source-of-funds/source-of-wealth verification are required for all PEPs. The complete KYC/AML file must be retained under Law 23 of 2015 and the UAF's record-keeping regulations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá (RPP) - Consulta de Disponibilidad de Nombre via the RPP online platform (www.registropublico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory naming under the Panamanian Commercial Code requires the proposed name to be legible in Latin script. Spanish-language names are standard; English names are permitted but must not consist solely of generic descriptors and must include the Spanish legal form suffix 'S.A.' or 'Sociedad Anónima'. Any non-Latin script name must be transliterated and filed with an official Spanish translation. Exact phonetic and homophonic matches with existing registered names are rejected by the registry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant, through its legal counsel, may submit a written 'Recurso de Reconsideración' before the Director of the Mercantile Registry within five (5) business days of written notification. If this is denied, a further 'Recurso de Apelación' may be lodged with the General Directorate of the Registro Público de Panamá within ten (10) business days. Alternatively, a corrected or modified name may be submitted without penalty, subject to the same clearance protocol.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only for the statutory registered address at the resident agent's office and for receipt of legal correspondence. For this 'On-Site Factory Pre-Shipment Quality Control and Audit Agency' classification, the virtual office cannot serve as the substantive operational or tax residence address if the company elects Panamanian tax residence. The company may maintain off-shore operating facilities while using a Panamanian registered agent, provided no local Panama-sourced revenue is generated without local substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate: approximately 20-25% annualised probability of an unannounced on-site inspection by the Ministry of Commerce and Industries (MICI) or the Panama National Tax Authority (DGI) if the company is Panamanian tax resident and has local employees or assets. As a low-risk, non-financial ISIC 7120 service, a purely offshore declaration profile reduces this probability to under 5%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation filing with the mercantile registry

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Resident agent service for the first fiscal year

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark annual resident agency fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registro Público de Panamá (RPP) / resident agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee plus standard compliance filing fee of the agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Incorporation registration and official issuance of the Public Registry Certificate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Post-incorporation Certificate of Legal Existence and Certificate of Good Standing (required for bank account opening)
Local courier, legal disbursements, and administrative resolution fee for the incorporation file
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Reimbursement of actual disbursements plus market-based administrative fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (Ley General de Sociedades Anónimas), as amended; arts. 1 (formation), 2 (public deed and registration), 4 (corporate name and domicile), 5 (capital stock), 33 (board of directors) and 36 (officers); supplementary registry rules and tariffs of the Registro Público de Panamá.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil (Public Registry of Panama, Mercantile Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (public deed of incorporation) together with the annexed Pacto Social / Estatutos
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital or escrow requirement applies to a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima; capital may be stated in registered or bearer shares and may remain unpaid until called by the board.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Escritura Pública de Constitución and the annexed Estatutos are hereby adopted as the corporation’s organic instruments. RESOLVED, that all shares validly subscribed by the initial stockholders are accepted and shall be entered in the capital account. RESOLVED, that the registered office is established at [PANAMA CITY ADDRESS] and that [RESIDENT AGENT FIRM] is appointed resident agent. RESOLVED, that [NAME], [NAME], and [NAME] are elected President, Secretary, and Treasurer, respectively, with authority to open bank accounts, execute inspection-service contracts, and retain counsel. RESOLVED, that the officers take all steps required to obtain the municipal Aviso de Operación, MICI permits, social security registration, and tax registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil, Name Reservation Desk, including the online digital filing module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application for the proposed corporate denomination followed by the suffix 'S.A.'. Provide the intended corporate object and the incorporator details. Pay the applicable name reservation stamp fee and obtain the Certificado de Nombre. Preserve the reservation until the deed of incorporation is executed and presented for registry.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application form
Copy of passport or valid ID of the incorporator / applicant
Payment receipt for name reservation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is identical or deceptively similar to an existing registered entity, the Registry will issue a formal objection; the applicant may file a reconsideration, submit a consent letter from the prior name holder, or reserve an alternate name without further delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Panamanian Notary Public (Notaría Pública) in Panama City
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a Panamanian attorney to prepare the public deed in Spanish. The deed must include the corporate name, registered office, resident agent, corporate objects covering ISIC 7120 commercial inspection and pre-shipment quality-control services, capital structure, number of shares, directors and officers. The incorporators must personally appear before the notary, sign the deed, and receive certified copies for registration.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Nombre
Passports or ID copies of all incorporators
Draft articles of incorporation and bylaws
Resident agent letter of acceptance
Power of attorney or signed appearance instructions, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies formal drafting defects or missing declarations, the deed may be corrected and re-executed before registration; a corrective addendum may be incorporated before the Registry filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration of the Public Deed at the Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the original public deed and legally certified copies to the Mercantile Section. Pay the statutory registration and stamp fees. The Registry will review the deed for legality and compliance, then inscribe the corporation, thereby granting legal personality. Upon registration, obtain the folio number and certified inscription data.
required_dossiers: Original Escritura Pública de Constitución with notarial seals
Notary certification of compliance with formalities
Receipt of payment of registry fees
Certified copy of the name reservation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues reparos (exceptions or defects), the applicant must submit written explanations, amend the deed by notarial corrective instrument, or comply with additional legalization within the statutory response period; reconsideration may be filed if the objection is disputed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Certified Registry Copies
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil, Certificate Issuance Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the deed has been entered in the mercantile register, request a Certificado de Persona Jurídica (Legal Entity Certificate) and certified copies of the registered deed and annotation pages. Verify that the corporate name, resident agent, directors and officers appear exactly as intended.
required_dossiers: Registry folio number or reference to the inscription
Application for legal entity certificate
Payment receipt for certification fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical or indexing errors, file a formal request for correction with the Registry, attaching the original inscription record, and obtain a corrected certificate before using it with banks or licensing agencies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Governance Organization and Appointment of Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección Mercantil for optional registration of powers; corporate records retained at the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board of directors by written consent or meeting. Adopt the pro-forma first board resolution, issue share certificates, register transfers in the share ledger, and record officer appointments in the corporate minute book. If officers require third-party representation powers, execute and notarize a Poder General and register it in the Public Registry.
required_dossiers: First board resolution / written consent
Share subscription and payment records
Share certificate stubs
Officer acceptance letters
Corporate minutes book and share register
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries a recorded Poder General, the board may adopt a ratifying resolution, correct the authorization by board consent, and re-present the power for registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating Notice, Tax Registry and Social Security Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipio de Panamá – Administración de Rentas / Aviso de Operación window, Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), and Caja de Seguro Social (CSS)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Aviso de Operación with the municipality for the registered office and any on-site office in Panama. Obtain the municipal license for the commercial activity. Register the corporation in the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC) at DGI, and register the employer and first employees with the CSS and MITRADEL as applicable.
required_dossiers: Certificate of incorporation / legal entity certificate
Aviso de Operación application form
Proof of registered office address and lease or title documents
RUC registration form
CSS employer registration form
Copy of ID or passport of legal representative
Fire safety certificate, if required by the municipality
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality requires zoning or physical inspection, submit a licensed engineer’s certificate and schedule the required inspection; if DGI or CSS rejects the application due to documentary discrepancies, resubmit corrected documents and use the mayoral filing process to verify the corporate legal existence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) – Dirección de Normas y Tecnología Industrial (DGNTI) and Comisión Panameña de Normas Industriales (COPANIT)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (municipal commercial operating notice); if accredited inspection work is offered, a conformity-assessment body registration under the COPANIT/ISO/IEC 17020 scheme may be required; an industrial manufacturing or factory-operating license is not required where the company performs only on-site inspection and quality-control audit services.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Evaluación de Riesgo Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I / low-impact environmental registration only; a full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) is not required for an administrative and on-site field inspection operation with no fixed industrial plant, no process wastewater, and no hazardous waste generation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial point-source wastewater or VOC emission unit is expected. Sanitary wastewater, if not connected to the municipal sewer, must meet Panama’s general effluent criteria, including BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L, COD ≤ 300 mg/L and total suspended solids ≤ 100 mg/L. Any waste oil, batteries, electronic waste or calibration chemicals must be transported and disposed of by a MiAMBIENTE-approved waste handler. General ambient air and noise standards apply to mobile inspection equipment used on client sites.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety inspection and certification by the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá for the registered office and any occupied floor; structural load and electrical installation certifications by a licensed Panamanian engineer; occupational health and safety plan and employer registration with the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL); periodic workplace hygiene and safety inspections are required once employees are contracted.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) - Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; online portal: Sistema de Gestión de Recaudo (SGR) via www.dgi.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must: (1) register its Panamanian Sociedad Anónima or foreign-entity branch with the Registro Público de Panamá through a licensed resident attorney; (2) obtain municipal and operating licenses if establishing physical premises in Panama; (3) apply for the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes) from DGI through the local legal representative, submitting a notarized power of attorney, certified charter/articles of incorporation, and proof of registered address; (4) activate the SGR e-credential and obtain the DGI ITBMS resolution; (5) undergo electronic invoicing enrollment with SEFA or an authorized e-invoicing provider before issuing any tax documents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Panama does not operate a U.S.-style check-the-box election. A Sociedad Anónima is a separate legal taxable entity under Panamanian law, taxed only on Panamanian-source income. Eligible taxpayers may elect the Simplified Small-Taxpayer regime for ITBMS purposes when annual gross income does not exceed PAB 36,000, or apply for special incentive regimes such as the Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime under Law 41 of 2007. No separate hybrid mismatch election is codified; general anti-abuse rules apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS - Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (VAT-type consumption tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No uniform monetary turnover threshold for ITBMS registration; any person habitually selling taxable movable goods or providing taxable services in Panama must register for RUC/ITBMS before commencing activities. A simplified small-taxpayer regime applies to taxpayers with annual gross income up to PAB 36,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama has a mandatory phased electronic invoicing regime (Facturación Electrónica) administered by DGI through SEFA or DGI-authorized private e-invoicing providers. Each invoice must be issued as a digitally signed XML document, transmitted in real-time to DGI, validated for fiscal authorization, and stamped with a unique electronic voucher number/QR code. API integration is required for system-to-system clearance, and export invoices must also be transmitted under the same fiscal authorization workflow before issuance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods from Panama qualify for the 0% ITBMS treatment when the goods are physically shipped outside Panamanian territory under a valid export customs declaration. Services supplied to non-residents for use entirely outside Panama, and services connected with international transportation or Panama Canal operations, fall outside the territorial scope of ITBMS. Exporter must hold the full documentary chain proving actual export and foreign receipt; the associated input ITBMS may be credited or refunded where properly attributable to export operations.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Declaración Única de Aduanas (DUA) - Customs Export Declaration
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill signed by the carrier
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT credit advice evidencing payment from the foreign buyer
Certificate of Origin when preferential treatment is claimed
Evidence of the foreign buyer's identity and tax residence (corporate registry excerpt or equivalent)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGI and Panama Customs jointly scrutinize export zero-rating claims. Incomplete, inaccurate, or fraudulent export documentation will reverse the 0% treatment, causing immediate assessment of ITBMS at 7% plus monthly interest and late-payment surcharges, penalties of up to 200% of the tax due under the Código Fiscal, and criminal liability for fiscal fraud. Export supporting documents must be retained for at least five years, and the exporter bears the burden of proof. Failure to evidence foreign receipt within the applicable 180-day period may recharacterize the transaction as a taxable domestic supply.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Panama has no central bank; the U.S. dollar is legal tender under full dollarization. Banking system regulation and AML supervision are exercised by the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP), while financial intelligence matters fall under the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Balboa is merely an accounting designation at parity with the U.S. dollar. Both current and capital accounts are fully convertible with no exchange controls, no prior authorization for foreign investment, and no profit remittance hurdles; dividends and repatriation can be moved freely.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Exporters have no statutory obligation to surrender export receipts and no mandatory conversion ratios. Proceeds may be retained, freely reinvested, or remitted in U.S. dollars without SBP or executive approval.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium. Panama does not maintain a separate EMI licensing passport; foreign EMIs may open settlement accounts or use local banks as payment gateways, but they need an SBP-licensed entity or a partnership with a local bank to access the clearing network. Legal constraints include the prohibition on taking deposits from the public without a banking license and UAF registration requirements for money or value transfer services.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Full remote opening is not generally available for non-resident S.A.s. At least one signatory or the legal representative must complete an in-person interview or have validly notarized and apostilled powers of attorney with certified attestation; many banks require ultimate beneficial owners to appear in person or by live video for higher-risk jurisdictions. A low-risk inspection agency can usually rely on Panamanian lawyer-introduced account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity on newly registered S.A. without operating history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Share register, apostilled articles of incorporation, notarized UBO declaration, passport copies, proof of registered agent relationship, and a bank reference from the subscribing shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds mismatched with inspection-fee income from international clients
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Client service contracts, purchase orders, inspection reports, invoices with payment terms, SWIFT credit confirmations, and FATCA / CRS classification of the beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent name spelling or sanction-list resemblance due to Spanish names
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized explanation of name variants, national identity or passport numbers, birth certificate or official identity index, negative news screening, and a signed AML questionnaire.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Funds are received via SWIFT MT103 with the purpose code 'Equity contribution to S.A.' or 'Foreign direct investment'; Panama requires no exchange license or central bank approval. The bank will perform source-of-funds verification; the wire must reference the entity legal name and RUC tax identification number. A capital escrow account can be used for bridge funding until inspection invoices are issued.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements are made via SWIFT MT103 or corresponding USD clearing through Fedwire/CHIPS; for large verification projects, commercial confirmed letters of credit with transferable documents are the preferred rail. Correspondent banks commonly include JPMorgan Chase, Citibank, or Bank of America.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Franchise Fee (Tasa Única) Annual Payment — Impuesto Único de Sociedades Anónimas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) with reconciliation against the Registro Público de Panamá
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 31 of the following year for calendar-year companies (within 3 months after fiscal year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge plus 1.5% monthly prorated interest on the unpaid fee; after two consecutive unpaid years the Public Registry classifies the company as delinquent and initiates administrative strike-off; six consecutive unpaid years permit administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Renta) with territorial-source income computation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: April 30 of the following year for calendar-year taxpayers; fiscal-year companies file within 4 months after year-end; quarterly advance payments apply to larger filers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% surcharge and monthly interest at the DGI rate; fines for late filing from B/. 500 to B/. 5,000; persistent non-filing permits assessed-tax liens, executive collection, and suspension of the taxpayer's operation license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Financial Statements (Estados Financieros Auditados) appended to the annual return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), per Executive Decree No. 170 of 1993
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same deadline as the annual income tax return: April 30 for calendar-year companies (within 4 months after fiscal year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Incomplete-return treatment, disallowance of deductions and recalculation of taxable income; fines up to B/. 5,000 for failure to attach the CPA audit report when the B/. 1,000,000 revenue threshold is met.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Registry Update (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Electronic Beneficial Ownership Archive under Law 129 of 2020 and Decreto Ejecutivo No. 3 of 2021
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 working days after any transfer of shares or change in ultimate beneficial ownership; zero-change years require confirmation of current UBO data with the annual income tax filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of B/. 5,000 to B/. 10,000 for untimely or false filings; deliberate concealment is treated as a tax and criminal offense; commercial registry operations may be blocked until the filing is regularized.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Continuous Resident Agent Service and Record Validation (Agente Residente)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Continuous annual obligation: maintained at incorporation, on renewal of the annual franchise fee, and at every registry filing (share capital changes, director changes, share transfers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Lapse of the resident agent triggers Public Registry suspension of corporate filings; prolonged vacancy leads to administrative strike-off of the corporation and loss of good standing for banking, visa, and contracting purposes.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit when gross income in the immediately preceding fiscal year reaches or exceeds B/. 1,000,000 (USD 1,000,000); audited financial statements must be signed by a Panamanian certified public accountant (CPA) and filed together with the annual income tax return. Companies below the threshold must still maintain financial statements available for DGI inspection.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panama Local GAAP converged with IFRS as endorsed by the Colegio de Contadores Públicos Autorizados de Panamá (CCPA); IFRS for SMEs is permitted for non-public-interest entities; statements are prepared in U.S. dollars / balboas (B/.) with Spanish as the operative language for the DGI.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Ultimate beneficial owners holding directly or indirectly more than 10% of capital or exercising effective control must be identified in the DGI Beneficial Ownership Archive. Any shareholding transfer that changes UBO must be declared within 15 working days. There is no standalone zero-change UBO anniversary renewal; the annual income tax return serves as the vehicle for reaffirming current UBO data, and share transfers evidenced in the share register must reconcile with the officer and director record at the Public Registry.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Shareholders' Meeting Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Board of Directors' Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 – USD 1,500 per year for a licensed resident agent (law firm) including registered office address services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – USD 6,000 per year for a commercial inspection and QC S.A. with annual revenue up to USD 5 million

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (Impuesto sobre la Renta, ISR) on net Panamanian-source taxable income
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial taxation excludes foreign-source revenue: on-site pre-shipment inspection and quality-control fees invoiced to and paid by non-resident principals, with services physically performed outside Panama, fall outside the ISR base. Qualified export-of-services revenue benefitting non-resident clients is exempt under Ley 41 de 2007. Annual inflation adjustment (Coeficiente de Ajuste por Inflación, CAIR) reduces the taxable base for entities with Panamanian-source gross revenue above the CAIR activation threshold. No annual franchise tax, no minimum capital tax, and no municipal patent (aviso de operación) complexity for a standard S.A. engaged solely in international inspection work. Small-taxpayer unified regime optional only for gross annual revenue below B/. 150,000, not recommended for cross-border inspection agencies above this volume.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 101 (Declaración Jurada de Renta) filed exclusively through the DGI electronic portal 'T@-Pán' (www.dgi.gob.pa) using the company's RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyentes).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three calendar months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year S.A., the return is due by March 31 of the following year. Electronic filing permits an automatic one-month extension request; payments must nevertheless be quantity-approximated to avoid surcharges.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RUC number, corporate name, fiscal period, registered agent (agente residente), address, economic activity code (ISIC 7120).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Panamanian RUC of the S.A.; foreign shareholders have no Form 101 filing obligation on the company's behalf, but their identity must be current in the Shareholders Registry and in the Beneficial Owner Registry when required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1 - Gross Panamanian-source revenue (ingresos brutos de fuente panameña)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All inspection, testing, audit and quality-control fees derived from services performed in Panama or exploited/utilized in Panama by a Panamanian-resident client.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exclude fees for factory inspections performed at foreign manufacturing sites where the service is not exploited in Panama and the payer is non-resident; attach a territoriality schedule with client name, site country, and contractual reference.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 2 - Exempt and foreign-source revenue (rentas de fuente extranjera y exentas)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue outside the territorial net: pre-shipment QC at overseas plants, on-site supplier audits abroad, product testing physically performed in foreign laboratories, and export-of-services revenue paid from abroad.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Substantiate simultaneously with inspection orders, factory gate reports, travel itineraries and entry stamps of inspectors, and the incoming wire/SWIFT or Wise payment credits from the foreign client. Calendar the periodic DGI audit test: personnel presence abroad must match the invoices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 5 - Deductible costs and expenses attributable to Panamanian-source revenue
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct and pro-rated expenses chargeable against Panamanian-source income, adjusted by the CAIR inflation coefficient; capital allowances and amortization.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not deduct costs attributed to foreign-source engagements against Panamanian-source income; intercompany overhead allocations must respect the arm's-length standard and should not create artificial Panamanian losses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 8 - Net taxable income (renta neta gravable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Panamanian-source gross revenue minus deductible expenses and CAIR adjustment; the base for the 25% ISR.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the territoriality schedule demonstrates 100% foreign-source receipts, declare zero net taxable income; the return must still be filed on time to avoid contravention fines.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 12 - Tax charge at 25% (tarifa del ISR)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 25% multiplied by net taxable income; credit is then applied for quarterly advance payments (Form 103) and prior-year overpayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a zero-taxable-income S.A., place zero in the tax-charge line and attach the territoriality schedule; DGI may still issue a 'determinación de oficio' if the schedule is missing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 14 - Net tax payable or refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance of tax after advance-payment credits and WHT credits; the balance must be paid via T@-Pán Pago or deposit to the DGI collection account.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Excess advance payments are creditable forward; refunds require a formal solicitud and DGI 'Visto Bueno'. Avoid carrying repeated refund balances, which attract audit scrutiny.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing/payment trigger the Article 718 fiscal recargo: 10% of the tax due per month or fraction, escalating from 10% (month 1) to 65% (after month 6), plus 1% monthly arrears interest. Non-filing is an Article 732 contravention punishable by administrative fines of B/. 100 to B/. 10,000 per infraction, RUC suspension, and, for persistent non-filers, enforced collection through bank embargo and asset seizure.
